subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers keep this umbrella as the human tracker, or split it into focused TUI, sessions_send, WeChat plugin, background-event, and activity-ordering items before implementation?
rationale: Source inspection confirms unresolved pieces, but one automated fix would cross core TUI/Gateway behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, and product-level session activity semantics.

options.title: Split and Route Focused Work
options.body: Keep this issue open until focused issues or PRs own each remaining behavior, with existing related items covering only the sessions_send and activity-ordering slices.

options.title: Keep This As The Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the human-owned tracker and block automation until maintainers reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close After Linked Work Lands
options.body: Close this issue only after focused linked fixes or decisions cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and Route Focused Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until focused issues or PRs own each remaining behavior, with existing related items covering only the sessions_send and activity-ordering slices.
